subject: Launch readiness check: enablement, pricing clearance, docs & support signoffs
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice@mercuryhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch readiness check: enablement, pricing clearance, docs & support signoffs

Team — quick cross-functional check ahead of the Mercury Health pilot launch next week. Goal is to get explicit signoffs in these areas so Sales can confirm the customer launch date (May 26). High-level asks below; please reply with status and blockers by EOD today.

1) Enablement: final slide deck + 1-pager for CSMs (owner: Marissa) — need published link and reviewer notes.
2) Pricing: confirmed any promotional pricing and trial terms; confirm if we need a one-off credit or updated SKU (owner: Karthik).
3) Docs: onboarding steps, API examples, and rate-limit guidance published to docs.redwood.ai (owner: Kimberly).
4) Support readiness: on-call assignment for week 1 and post-launch SLA expectations (not in thread but cc'ing Mercury).

Attachments: mh_enablement_deck_v1.pdf (draft), pricing_playbook_v3.xlsx (pricing scenarios).

Notes: Laura — can you confirm GTM comms cadence? I plan to collect signoffs and send a single launch confirmation to Mercury by 5/18 6pm PT.

Thanks,
Connor
Sr. PM, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch readiness check: enablement, pricing clearance, docs & support signoffs

Connor — working through the deck this morning. Quick status:
- Deck: slides 1–12 are final; slide 13 (integration FAQ) needs a snippet from Docs team. I attached suggested trainer notes inline in the deck (see comments).
- 1-pager: first draft complete; will publish to internal Confluence by 2pm PT and share the link.
- Training: can run a 30-minute live session on 5/24 for CSMs; will record.

Blocker: need final API rate-limit language from Kimberly for slide 13 and for the 1-pager.

Marissa
Director, Enablement
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch readiness check: enablement, pricing clearance, docs & support signoffs

Quick pricing note — we ran scenarios against Mercury's expected usage. Recommendation: standard pilot terms (no upfront fee), but provide a $5k usage credit to cover spike risk in week 1. That keeps contract clean and avoids an SKU change.

If Legal needs to attach the credit to an MSA amendment, Tim (cc'd externally) can advise — otherwise Sales can apply the credit in billing. No technical blockers.

Karthik
Head of Pricing & Packaging

On the Docs side — publishing plan and ETA:
- Onboarding guide: published draft to docs staging at 13:30 PT. URL: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/mh/onboarding (will move to prod after review).
- API examples: included an example for prefix-caching and recommended batch sizes for Mercury's pattern.
- Rate limits: added conservative guidance (60 req/min default) and a note on burst handling; welcome feedback from Marissa for the deck.

One ask: can we confirm whether Mercury needs a higher burst for the integration test? Alice — can you confirm expected peak calls/min during the integration week?

Kimberly
Senior Technical Writer, Docs

Thanks for the roundup, Connor. GTM comms plan:
- Sales confirmation to Mercury: 5/18 6pm PT (pending signoffs in this thread).
- Internal ops email: 5/24 9am PT with training invite to CSMs and support rotation.
- External launch email to Mercury with runbook + support on-call details: 5/25 12pm PT.

On credits — I support Karthik's $5k pilot credit. Tim — if Legal needs wording, happy to loop you for an amendment.

- Marissa: publish 1-pager and training slot (due 5/18 EOD).
- Kimberly: confirm final rate-limit text (due 5/18 4pm).
- Karthik: confirm billing path for credit (done).
- Connor: send final confirmation to Alice once items are green.

Laura

Connor / Laura — quick answers from the Mercury side:
- Burst: we'll run a constrained integration test on 5/24 with estimated peak ~90 req/min for a 10-minute window. We can increase if needed for the pilot, but please advise if we should request a temporary uplift.
- Credit: $5k credit is fine from our procurement team. Tim will confirm amendment language.
- Training: 5/24 10:00 PT works for our CSMs.

Thanks — Alice
Head of Integrations, Mercury Health
